annotations.title: Check an LLC formation order's USDC payment

description: Reports the USDC payment state of an LLC or nonprofit formation order created by formation.checkout: awaiting, paid, expired, underpaid or held, plus whether the founder has confirmed by email (required within 48 hours of payment). Reading the chain also records a payment that just arrived. Free; does not consume credits.
name: formation.payment_status

isError.description: True when the tool could not complete successfully.

text.description: Human-readable tool result (also mirrored in content[].text).
